jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.content: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p><p>Fabrikam is looking for an Operations Analyst to join our Raleigh logistics team. You will build the reports our planners rely on every day and help us ship faster.</p><p><strong>Requirements</strong></p><ul><li>2+ years of experience in operations or analytics</li><li>Strong SQL and Excel</li><li>Experience with Tableau or Power BI</li><li>Clear written communication</li></ul><p><strong>Benefits</strong></p><ul><li>Health, dental and vision from day one</li><li>401(k) with a 4% match</li></ul>

jobs.content: <p>Pick, pack and ship orders in our Durham warehouse. Requirements: able to lift 50 pounds.</p>
